answer: Make every identity pay a small, non-transferable toll of verifiable work at a public jetty each epoch: the agent completes an assigned micro-task and receives an onyx receipt, a hash-chained token bound to its identity and the previous epoch's receipt, so receipts cannot be copied, sold, or reused. A Sybil attacker running a hundred fake agents must do the work a hundred times, paying a ferrous-hard linear cost per identity, while an honest agent pays once. The toll is too small to burden one real agent, yet scales exactly with the number of identities, so farming identities stops paying.
